class.name: OcgStdselectEdgefilter
class.brief_description: A framework to define a filter to select a specific type of edge. The types available include: - any edge - a linear edge - a circular edge.
class.description: ! A framework to define a filter to select a specific type of edge. ! The types available include: ! - any edge ! - a linear edge ! - a circular edge.

method.name: StdSelect_EdgeFilter
method.description: Constructs an edge filter object defined by the type of edge Edge.

method.name: SetType
method.description: Sets the type of edge aNewType. aNewType is to be highlighted in selection.

method.name: Type
method.description: Returns the type of edge to be highlighted in selection.
